tweet.text:
🎯 STRUCK: A senior Hamas terrorist and additional terrorists operating within Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis, southern Gaza, to eliminate the threat they posed.

Hamas used the hospital complex as a hub for military and terrorist activities against IDF troops and Israel, including:
• Storing weapons.
• Conducting interrogations and torture.
• Operating command-and-control rooms.
• Using hospital facilities as observation posts and shelters for terrorists.

Hamas’ use of the hospital for military purposes constitutes a blatant violation of international law and endangers patients, medical personnel & civilians.

Further updates on its results will follow.
